movie.title: The Birthday Party
movie.overview: Thomas, Nora and their teenage daughter Ida live on remote marshland. Social contact is limited, as they only have one neighbour, Cristina, an Italian painter. As the two households plan a surprise birthday party for Nora, strange disturbances begin to occur and unease rolls over the marsh.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Living in isolated marshland, a family's preparations for a surprise birthday party with their sole neighbor are disrupted by eerie, unsettling disturbances.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Thomas, Nora, and their teenage daughter Ida lead a quiet, highly secluded life on a remote stretch of marshland. Their only social connection is Cristina, an Italian painter who lives nearby. When the two households join forces to organize a surprise birthday party for Nora, strange and eerie events begin to plague the area. As an atmosphere of dread settles over the landscape, sinister tensions threaten the peaceful existence of the tight-knit group.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Thomas, Nora, and their teenage daughter Ida reside in a secluded home nestled deep within remote marshland. Far removed from modern society, their daily life is defined by quiet routine and vast isolation. Their singular connection to the outside world is Cristina, an enigmatic Italian painter living in the neighboring property. The fragile peace of their community begins to shift when Thomas, Ida, and Cristina secretly plan a surprise birthday celebration for Nora. As preparations get underway, minor, inexplicable phenomena start occurring across the marshy landscape. Shadows, strange noises, and unnatural disruptions subtly fracture the quiet routine of both households. Unspoken tensions surface among the family members as the atmosphere turns increasingly suffocating and hostile. Paranoia takes root, forcing Thomas and Nora to confront uncomfortable truths about their isolated lifestyle. What was meant to be a joyful gathering rapidly descends into psychological distress as the true nature of the marshland's threat begins to reveal itself.
aiEnrichment.synopsis:
Set against the backdrop of a vast, remote marshland, *The Birthday Party* explores the fragile boundary between peaceful isolation and psychological dread. Thomas, Nora, and their teenage daughter Ida share an almost entirely self-contained life, relying heavily on the quiet routines of their environment. Their only regular human interaction is with Cristina, an eccentric Italian painter whose nearby home serves as their sole connection to the outside world.

When Thomas and Ida team up with Cristina to throw a surprise birthday party for Nora, the mundane routines of their secluded life begin to fracture. What starts as minor, easily dismissed occurrences quickly escalates into a persistent sequence of strange disturbances that ripple across the landscape. The claustrophobic open space of the marsh becomes a source of growing anxiety, turning neighbors and family members against one another as dread takes hold. Rich in mood and psychological tension, the story examines how extreme isolation can distort reality when the unknown begins to encroach on the places we feel safest.

story_structure.resolution: The aftermath of the party settles over the marsh, leaving the family to cope with the unsettling changes to their lives and their isolated home.

story_structure.risingAction: Escalating unexplained incidents and mounting tension across the marsh force the family and their neighbor to confront the unnerving mystery disrupting their preparations.
